project_name: Indian Rounds (IR) - Travel Lead Management CRM

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Enterprise CRM requires authority, clarity, and function-first design. The Swiss Brutalist aesthetic adapted for modern SaaS ensures data density doesn't become overwhelming. Focus is on typography and high-contrast metric visualization.

body.usage: Tables, body text, form inputs, labels

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Optical clarity and tight data density with ample container padding.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 inside cards to let data breathe.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum. Avoid heavy rounding for enterprise tools.

components.surfaces: Neumorphism/Flat hybrid. Background: Flat White. Border: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Shadow: None by default. Hover: shadow-sm, -translate-y-[1px].
components.cards: Avoid overusing card wrappers. Use 'Grid Borders' (border-collapse look) where possible to present dense data cleanly.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Use sticky headers, dense row padding (py-2 or py-3), left-align data, right-align numbers.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Primary: bg-[#106EBE] hover:bg-[#0c5799] text-white. Large buttons for main CTAs.
components.forms: Shadcn Input, Select, DatePicker. Labels must be uppercase and tracking-wide. Inputs need sharp borders, no background fill.
components.pills: Use the defined status colors. Rounded-full, px-3 py-1, text-xs font-semibold, 1px solid border matching the status definition.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Provides professional, clean look for dense dashboards.

motion.hover: Subtle color shifts and micro-translations (e.g., hover:-translate-y-0.5).
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for table rows or feed items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Mint Green (#0FFCBE) uses dark text (#024a37) when used as background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sales-dashboard-kpi-total').

login_background.description: Abstract blue and mint geometric background. Use for the Login page split screen or hero graphic.

empty_state_1.description: Modern travel agency office setting. Use as an accent image in empty states or onboarding screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is used for Headings and KPIs, and 'Manrope' for body text and tables.
Implement the specific color-coded status pills exactly as defined in the colors.status section to match the workflow.
Focus on data density. Use the 'CONTROL ROOM' grid layout for the dashboards.
Implement dark mode using Tailwind's 'dark:' variant mapping to the surface.dark colors.
Do NOT use Material UI. Strictly use Shadcn components as requested.
Add data-testid to all interactive components.
Use Phosphor Icons for sidebars and quick actions.
